name: London manufactured-gas lighting network
description: Manufactured gas distributed through pipes supplied lamps across London.

impact.note: One city's network; piped light was a new ability for its streets and houses, and gas utilities elsewhere were built on its model and people.

places.note: Place refers to the sourced event; historic political boundaries are not inferred.

date.basis: Date stated in the cited source.

events.statement: Westminster Bridge was illuminated by gas lamps at the end of 1813.

evidence.supports: The museum describes gas lighting on Westminster Bridge in 1813 and roughly 50,000 London gas lamps with 300 miles of pipes by the 1820s; it dates the company’s foundation to 1812.

events.caveats: This is one observed lighting application, not the first gas lamp or proof of citywide coverage.
